source_note: Replaces the hardcoded medications INSERT that used to live in sql/schema.sql and sql/reset_clean.sql (removed Aug 2026 — see those files' own comments for why: a wrong baked-in start_date for Repatha/Wegovy caused real duplicate rows on restore). This is now the canonical medications seed for a clean install: import via import.php (Export/Import page) or the godaddy_restore_from_file_flow.json Node-RED flow (copy to /share/lucius_restore_import.json, fire its manual trigger) after running schema.sql or reset_clean.sql. Repatha/Wegovy correctly start 2025-08-14 (Thursday) — all other entries start 2025-08-12 (Tuesday), matching Ward's real medical history (see ForWard/wardstock_restore_from_sql_backup.json, the source this was cross-checked against).
